newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian bourse still in doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian bourse still in doldrums.

text.p: Lithuania's fledging bourse remained in the doldrums on Thursday, brokers said.
There were no bloc trades and central market volume was only 129,000 litas, where market leader Vilniaus bank saw its share price remain unchanged at 1,000 litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was just under 600,000 litas and the yield spread was 10.95 percent to 14.88 percent for papers with one and three month maturities.
Lithuania's young bourse has struggled to regain momentum since the country was hit by a banking crisis late last year.
Few listings are actively traded on a regular basis and the roller-coaster secondary T-bill market fluctuates wildly from a few thousand to millions of litas from session to session.
